status_summary: EO 14155 (signed 2025-01-20) began the WHO withdrawal, and HHS and the State Department announced it complete on 2026-01-22. EO 14162 (signed 2025-01-20) directed withdrawal from the Paris Agreement; the UN depositary recorded the notice on 2025-01-27 and the withdrawal took effect on 2026-01-27. EO 14199 (signed 2025-02-04) ended participation in the UN Human Rights Council, barred UNRWA funding, ordered a 90-day UNESCO review and ordered a 180-day review of all international organizations and treaties. A State Department statement of 2025-07-22, read through third-party copies, announced a UNESCO exit effective 2026-12-31. A presidential memorandum signed 2026-01-07 (published 2026-01-16) directs agencies to take immediate steps to withdraw from 66 organizations: 35 non-UN bodies, including the IPCC, and 31 UN entities, including the UNFCCC, where withdrawal means ending participation and funding to the extent permitted by law. The UN depositary recorded the UNFCCC withdrawal notice on 2026-02-27, effective 2027-02-27. The UNESCO and UNFCCC exits are announced but not yet effective, and effective dates for the other exits on the 66-body list were not verified.

timeline.event: EO 14155 signed (published 2025-01-29): the US intends to withdraw from the WHO; funding transfers paused, personnel recalled, and negotiation of the WHO pandemic agreement and International Health Regulations amendments halted.
EO 14162 signed (published 2025-01-30) directs the withdrawal of the United States from the Paris Agreement and a review of other international environmental agreements.
The UN Secretary-General, as depositary, records the US notification of withdrawal from the Paris Agreement, to take effect on 2026-01-27.

EO 14199 signed (published 2025-02-10): no US participation in the UN Human Rights Council, no UNRWA funding, a 90-day UNESCO membership review, and a 180-day State Department review of all international organizations and treaties with withdrawal recommendations.

The State Department announces the US will withdraw from UNESCO under Article II(6) of the UNESCO constitution, effective 2026-12-31, with the US a full member until then (statement read through third-party copies); the exit is not yet effective as of 2026-10-12.
timeline.source: State Department statement (copy hosted by Poder360)

timeline.event: Presidential memorandum directs immediate steps to withdraw from 66 organizations (35 non-UN, 31 UN), citing the State Department review under EO 14199; further review continues (published 2026-01-16).

HHS and the State Department announce the US has completed its WHO withdrawal, one year after EO 14155; the release says the US stopped WHO funding and withdrew personnel during the year and will coordinate only in a limited way to finish the exit.
The US withdrawal from the Paris Agreement takes effect, on the date stated in the UN depositary notification.
The UN Secretary-General, as depositary, records the US notification of withdrawal from the UNFCCC, which takes effect for the US on 2027-02-27, one year after receipt.

title: Withdraw from international organizations and agreements judged contrary to US interests
uncertainties: The UNESCO effective date rests on the State Department statement as reproduced by two third-party hosts (Poder360 and GlobalSecurity.org), which agree; the original page on the State Department site was not opened. Effective dates for exits other than WHO, Paris, UNESCO and UNFCCC were not verified. A limited search found no lawsuit, rescission or new withdrawal tranche after February 2026; an E&E News report of 2026-01-20 described legal debate but no filed case, and absence of evidence from a limited search is not proof.
